name: ModelVariant169_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant169_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a trail of growing grid copies travels from one of the slot's parts towards a point in front of the other slot, rings pulse on the part and on that point, a widening beam of ring segments joins them, rings burst out of the point and a screen flash ends it); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the grids, rings and beam, packs three texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 during the delay and first period, 4 while the copies travel, 1 once after them, 0 while the rings burst and 2 at the end; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-186 and 316 images build it from the same source without the work-size printf and bind its data names 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
